I wish steam had a maybe lol. Let me say why; The game's atmosphere is awesome! It also some interesting monsters! It has a monster I have been talking about for years that no one has made! I wont really say what but the monsters are pretty awesome. The hallucination thing is unreal, i don't think ive played a game with all this before. What i don't like is that it crashed a couple times. I have to run it on medium with frame gen just to be able to record/stream at the same time. im sure if i wasnt doing that i would be fine running the game higher and just playing it. (look at my specs, i am a mid range pc guy) oh, also the price seems high... maybe its not and we didnt really get far into the game in the time we played... there are large maps, quests, items (I wish we could buy weapons for the trip down lol) but hey its not bad! The right kind fo person will utterly love this game with its asthetic and atmosphere... :D if you are expecting a run and loot like lethal company, its not like that.. its more of a quake in fear whilst wandering around hearing terrifying noises while you don't know if the person with you is your friend or not kinda thing lol :D

The Mound it's intense and horrifying co-op adventure, which nails a lot of things like the atmosphere, sound design, world building, brutal combat and needs to work a few others. A lot of the complaints stem from misunderstanding the game, it's lovecraftian survival horror meant to make you feel helpless and anxious, you're supposed to play stealthy, pick your fights, and deal with the timer that ramps up difficulty since progression is through unlocks and contracts not infinite fighting or extraction shooter loot. Despite its technical shortcomings like optimization, there's a really fun and intense co-op horror game here. I don't agree with the complaints in other reviews about the movement (no jumping and all that). It actually fits the survival horror perfectly think Resident Evil 7-style movement. This isn't Darktide or L4D2, and it doesn't try to be. It's carving out its own spin on the formula. There's definitely room for improvement, and the devs have already mentioned they're working on a blocking/parrying system. But even with what’s there right now, the game feels genuinely scary and intense. To the devs: don’t completely give in to what everyone wants and water down your vision. It’s never easy being innovative, and complaints are part of the deal when you try something different. Can’t wait to see what future updates do with this!

1，操作僵硬，无法格挡，无法闪避，无法跳跃，上台阶会卡脚 2，武器系统只有斧头，矛，弓箭能用。（用枪和弩会积累噪音值而伤害却没有增加）（用刺剑，斧锤，小刀会被格挡掉落武器，反击掉血） 3，护甲系统，只能穿头盔，穿盔甲跑步会积累噪音值。盔甲穿上就脱不下来。 4，血量，这游戏伤害最高的是队友变异后给你来一刀导致的流血，没绷带就等死 5，视角，游戏里大量使用第三人称视角，扑到，上阶梯，吐蜈蚣（至今没发现做什么能避免吐蜈蚣）等，没法关闭偶尔看还行，看多了巨烦跑着跑着切个视角吐个蜈蚣。 6，任务，财宝任务门口逛逛捡够就可以走了（白沙滩跑刀的来），净化触手怪任务（要先背图规划路径，只能跑最短路径，腐化扩散速度巨快不跑最短路径紫色腐化会把路堵死），日志任务，一路跑拿了放马车上就可以撤了。 7，任务奖励，就不合理多捡财宝没有收益达到任务目标就可以撤，多给的15的代币根本没用，没有深入探索的动力，没有获取财宝的快感。 8，拿东西财宝的时候强制看动画，强制切换物品，没法关闭 9，代币，除了买地图根本没用，其他道具全部加起来都不如不如一把斧头。大部分怪追不上你，不如拿着地图跑图。强化武器没有任何作用，雕像也没有特别有用的，不如用开放代币购买武器，装备，皮肤，补给品等，不如没有动力去获取。 10，任务给初始物资，一个也给怎么多，四个人也是给怎么多这合理吗？除了矛，斧，头盔，弓箭，水壶，绷带，其他全部丢马车，没给近战武器就只能拿小刀找有斧头的怪激情肉搏。 11，皮肤，没把武器每次都要重新上皮肤，就不能通用吗？ 12，营地内的升级设施没用，鹿，火柴没必要捡。 13，船上能听的歌就一首，能多放几首就好了。 14，结算动画，太久了能简化一点或者取消就好了。 15，地图可用参照物不多，不带地图经常迷路，想玩的每次到新地图建议拿着地图绕几圈把拿日志的路背下来，不然很折磨。单人玩可以关闭队友纯跑图，多人玩大概率变成胡闹厨房，玩野队有人吃到迷路不走大概率全队被觉醒之后的无限刷怪围死。 16，净化触手怪任务，逼着去背图还要最短路径，扩散速度快的离谱。 17，蜘蛛怪追到天荒地老唯一一个不能脱离仇恨的怪，近战强制清空你血条。 18，小怪触手，被控到手上的武器会掉还不能切武器怎么解控你告诉我？而且在前摇后摇的时候的能被其他怪物攻击，怪一多触手控完被扑到又被触手空强制看十几秒被围殴动画，满血被控到死。 19，噪音值，只能积累没法降下来，满了之后随机传送加刷怪物。别穿盔甲别干会出声音的事情。 历经十五小时流程已单人通关，除了雕像全收集，这游戏单人比多人简单，单人纯跑图什么怪都不用打，纯做任务。 但是克苏鲁美术氛围还是值几十块的，其他的纯折磨人。

I'm gonna give a cautionary thumbs up for this game. Pros: -Phenomenal atmosphere -Some of the best graphics/lighting I have ever seen in a game -Sound design will make your skin crawl -Co-op is great -Each mission feels pretty different than the next depending on how you approach it Cons: -Matchmaking is awful. -Combat feels a bit janky -Weapons breaking feels way out of place for what this game should be. If I'm not going to get a lot of ammo, I shouldn't have to worry about my only other weapon's durability. -Movement feels off...not sure how to say it, but it just feels weird to navigate. Especially without a dodge or jump. If this game released as an early access title, none of these complaints would be here. As a full release, unfortunately, this game just doesn't feel up to standards. That being said, I love it. I played a lot of the demo and plan on playing a lot more going forward. Depending on how the devs treat the feedback going forward is going to determine the fate of this game. I understand every dev team has a vision, but there's also a factor of accessibility that goes into a game's fun factor. It doesn't need to be easy, however, it feels like you get punished for literally every choice you make. I am very familiar with the lore of Lovecraft and understand how messed up his world is. But this is also a game and there needs to be some give and take with punishment.

Like all the other reviews I think this game has great potential. However there are some key issues right now that I think need to be addressed. Multiplayer has some insane desync issues at the moment. It's hard to tell what is desync and what is the games deliberate mind tricks but I have had enemies make visible attacks on my friend that then somehow hits me. There have been times where we attack the same enemy and their position is just different enough that we end up hurting each other. Some of that I imagine is the mind trick mechanic but I'm sure it isn't all of it. There is some rubber banding both on the player and npcs too. My other issue is balance. I understand that the game is hard, but it feels like too much of the game is out of your control. RNG plays a huge role in the equipment you are given at the start of a mission. If you don't get the axe, good luck. I'm also really not a fan of weapons breaking. It seems pretty difficult to consistently find new tools and weapons in a mission so when your weapon breaks you just feel like you are ♥♥♥♥♥♥. Some of the equipment and weapons also just feel a bit off. The bow and arrow in particular provides very little feedback so it is difficult to tell what you are doing. Is the arrow fully drawn? Don't know. If the devs work out some of the bugs and listen to some of the community feedback this game could be really good. I'm just not sure I can recommend it in its newly released state.

The Mound gives the player the most accurate Lovecraftian Horror experience in my opinion. It features a spot-on team of artists, who are clearly dedicated to the story, not just the craft. Though it does need some polish in the UI and other minor areas, it's been made clear by their VERY communicative team, that these will be fixed. Whereas in many games, you play as John Badass, a plot-armored soldier with 999+ years of training. In The Mound, you play as an ordinary person, going up against things no mortal man should be able to even fathom. It SHOULD be a miracle for you to succeed, and it often times feels that way! The forest itself is alive, every careless action, cut branch, or loud noise, the forest will react in kind. The game features an arsenal of Eldritch entities that continues to keep me on my toes with alternative gameplay loops and tactics to test my survivability. With that in mind, I cannot give this game anything short of immense praise, and a TON of hours of gameplay!

I've played dozens of mixed games, I almost always fall on one side of the positive/negative side. The Mound is the most deserving of a mixed rating out of any I've played The game's aesthetic and atmosphere is absolutely supreme. The death screen is horrifying and so deeply sets the weight of your failure. You're resigned to a fate worse than death. Monster designs are amazing, but it falls into that spot where it over uses zombies and not enough Lovecraftian horrors. The co-op sanity system is genuinely so unique and fresh. 2 person checks on everything, you can't trust that anything you're seeing is real. Found a pristine, high tier rifle? Well you might actually be holding a stick and you'll only know when you go to use it or your ally tells you that you're holding a stick Your friend's model might be replaced with one of an enemy, you'll find that it was an ally when you hit them if you aren't communicating. Sticking together is not a suggestion. And it's not like something you'd see in Left 4 Dead or Vermintide. The jungle and it's curse will actively begin warping your mind and singling you out. Enemies will spawn that your comrades will not see until they get closer. Enemies will approach that are only interested in you. You need to go back to safety to remedy the effect, even so, you'll never go back to complete normalcy. Mechanically, it's definitely a mixed bag. The core concept of disrupting the forest is a good one. It makes you consider every action as every sound you make well upset the forest. If you decide to get turtled up in armor, you're now making noise when you run. Breaking a lock of a case is done in the hope that what's inside was worth it. This has its determents, while guns are powerful, they're rarely worth using due to making so much noise. That shot drastically reduces the amount of time you have until the forest awakens. At that point, your chances of survival drop to the point that it's a matter of luck as to whether you're making it out. There is a cart in the game to store items and treasure you find. It follows along as you progress. The cart can be used to revive allies if you pick them up and place them in it. It serves as a mobile sanity restore point and leaves behind a salt trail to guide you through the path the cart has followed. It has an interaction that will have the cart return to the extraction point, however there is legitimately no reason to ever use it. It causes the driver to blow a horn which makes a lot of noise and enemy spawns drastically increase. Needs reworked in some way. Extraction loses everything you left with, you will not keep any weapons or gear. Instead, you have a money value you must meet to complete missions. All your items move to this goal. Getting more than the mission demands nets you extra money and XP, capping out of you meet 2x the goal I believe it would be improved if you were able to select 1 item to keep if you're over 2x and taking that item would not drop you below the threshold, as it would help with the next system I believe needs improvement. Mission selection has you choose a contract, this is your objective and what gear you'll receive when you go into the mission. The issue is that it's completely randomized when you choose. There are times the contract doesn't offer a viable load out. Sometimes you'll only have guns available, but guns don't work if it's raining. After you choose a contract, you choose a map location to do the mission. You can't preview this before you've set a contract that cannot be changed. If it's raining everywhere then you've effectively lost before the mission even began. Missions have tier levels that dictate the reward you'll receive. Contracts are random, but you'll see which tier of contract you'll get next if you complete one of your current ones. I'm not a fan of this as you don't get to choose what type of mission you're doing. Most of the time its to find treasure, but others it's hunt a monster or extract a survivor. I think it would be better if you simply got to choose a mission type and tier, or even if you received a currency that you could use to upgrade contracts to a higher tier. There doesn't feel like there's player agency in the current system and you're simply at the mercy of what the game decides to give you Melee combat doesn't feel great. As others have said, there's no block or anything. This means that if you don't kill an enemy in 2 hits, you are going to take damage. No way around it. While I think a dedicated block would make things too easy, I believe a shield that allows for a block at the cost of not being able to use your weapon's special attack or use 2 handed weapons would be a good trade-off so you could have one team member as a dedicated tank There are several characters and you unlock more as you complete survivor extraction missions. Unfortunately, they have no personality, do not speak, and all first person hands are the same regardless. If they spoke, I believe a lot would be added to the atmosphere as sanity focused gameplay is natural for spoken dialogue, it would also have the benefit of tipping you off to something that's going on as it's happening and add punishment to the salty system as your character screams. I believe small perks to the characters would be a good addition, like the lady who stabbed a man have benefits to the knife, priest more effective with the crucifix, the thief having slightly better drop rates from enemies, and the pirate reloading pistols slightly faster. Maybe if characters started with a piece of equipment that fit their character, but that might make things too easy. The game has no proper tutorial, you'd think that the prologue would teach you the basics but it's absolutely nothing. No idea why it isn't just a cutscene that plays when you start a new game. You need to go to the guidebook in the pause menu to learn to play, which I did not know existed until I played 5 expeditions. They should really have that as an item interaction before you start the first mission that shows the cart and treasure. Make players flip through the most crucial pages, then it's on them if they don't read it. All in all? I'll say no as this is by all rights an early access game. People are saying it's too hard, which I wouldn't go that far, it's just that the game gives you no inclination as to how you're supposed to play it. Make sure you know what you're getting into ahead of time. This is a survival horror and you aren't playing as John Explorer. You're a little wimp and you're not going to survive on your own. EDIT: Do not buy as a solo player. There is little enjoyment to be had. You get an AI companion that is simultaneously completely useless and absolutely cracked. He has an unbreakable machete, a crossbow with infinite ammo, and he can revive you without ammonia salts that you would typically need. The same is inversely true where you can revive him for no cost. His AI is abysmal, he just goes off on side quests and you won't see him for long periods of time. This means that you are losing sanity much faster as you are alone. Sometimes he won't revive you because he doesn't feel like it. I'm going into this review with full transparency as someone who's played both the Full Access version and the current Open Beta. I first found this game through a TikTok showing off the insane delusions you'll experience. I had absolutely no idea what I was getting into, and after spending time with it, I wanted to share both what I enjoyed and where I think the game could improve. My biggest surprise was that this is an extraction game. Going in, I expected more of a traditional survival game. While survival is still a major aspect, the gameplay loop feels much closer to Lethal Company than I expected. That's not necessarily a bad thing, as extraction games are right up my alley, but I do think the marketing gives a slightly different impression. One thing I found frustrating is that you don't really keep anything between expeditions. Every run feels like starting over, and while I understand that's part of the intended design, I personally wish there was a bit more long-term progression. Another issue is how confusing the game can be. There is a helpful guidebook, but even with that, my partner and I often felt lost and unsure of what we were supposed to do next. This is definitely a game that could benefit from better onboarding or clearer objectives. I've put around eight hours into it, and I still don't feel confident explaining the gameplay loop to someone who's never played. For a "Full Access" release, I'm also surprised by how many core mechanics are still missing. Basic features like jumping, dodging, parrying, and other movement options aren't available yet. I know the developers have already stated that some of these features are coming, but launching without mechanics that many players consider standard doesn't leave the strongest first impression. That said, I've genuinely enjoyed my time with the game. It runs surprisingly well on my older PC, even on lower graphics settings, and multiplayer has been smooth in my experience. The insanity mechanics are easily the highlight, creating some genuinely memorable and hilarious moments. The atmosphere is fantastic, and when everything comes together, the game feels unlike much else I've played recently. Overall, I'd recommend it if you enjoy cooperative extraction games and don't mind learning through trial and error. There's a really fun game here with a unique identity, but it could benefit from a bit more polish, clearer direction, and a few missing gameplay features before it fully reaches its potential. p.s wtf is a tutu cylinder?

总体上来说，游戏还可以，但是还能更好。 首先，游戏的内容重复度比较大：地图是固定的，图里刷新宝藏的位置是固定的，但是刷不刷宝藏以及刷什么价格的宝藏是随机的（本人在部分地图上找到过价值700+的珍贵宝藏疑似是刷新位置固定）。 其次，游戏内存在圣象守护者（就是船底层的那几个木雕）系统，但是bug非常多而且每一个都非常的难受：制作组能不能出来说明一下这个守护者系统到底是要怎么回事，为什么明明已经购买的雕像不能装上牛车，为什么重启后又能装上？你的设计到底是只用购买一次雕像就可以随意更换使用，还是只有更换雕像时才需要花费100币，又或者说是每一次任务都需要重新花钱购买？以上描述的场景我都TM遇到了，而且不止一次。 再次，游戏中的这个吐虫子的事件，是不是太频繁了？咱们没活了可以不整事件，就正常游玩难度就不低了，现在还频繁地毫无征兆地突然吐虫子，每只虫子都硬控角色一段时间，你能想象传送门任务正在冲刺过紫色地块时突然吐虫子然后直接判定秒杀吗？你又能想象战斗时突然吐虫然后起身被怪包围并且打一套的感受吗？只能说没活硬整，一场任务下来队伍里每个人都要吐四五次虫子，说是绦虫猪肉吃多了吗？ 还有最后，游戏不可以调伽马值，但是游戏内不少地图又刚需进洞，但是这也太黑了吧？又不是把把都给提灯或者火把，不给武器遇到怪我还能跑，不给光源还让我进洞是不是太过分了？逼着玩家开英伟达滤镜？ 最后总结：游戏我个人认为还是好玩的，尤其是和几个好友一起开黑的时候，游戏内存在大量幻觉假象模糊了现实与幻境的边界，全员在亦真亦假间迷失自我，非常有意思（拿着根木棍硬说是燧发枪的你XD）；但是缺点也有很多：游戏难度有点高，部分玩家优化表现特别差经常闪退和崩溃（虽然我还没遇到），游戏全员死亡后不进行失败结算或返回船上反而卡在了死亡界面，以及上文提到的最让我难受的各种问题。我从游戏demo试玩的时候就开始游玩了，潜力非常大，但是正式版发售到现在，制作组连一个热修更新甚至一个社区公告都没有发布，很容易让人怀疑是准备圈一波钱然后准备跑路。 最后的最后，给新手玩家一点建议：1、首先游戏，绝对绝对绝对，不要单走，孤独值过高会引来各种超级强力的事件和怪物；2、游戏内存在隐藏的噪音值系统，玩家的部分行动（如穿铁甲奔跑、开枪、砍树和折断树枝等）和部分怪物和动物会产生大量噪音值，噪音值短时间内累积过高同样会触发各种恐怖的怪物和事件，所以不要拿到枪就猛猛开枪了；3、前期可以在地图“白沙滩”重复游玩积累原始资金（把把百万撤离），中期推图建议购买地图防止迷路。4、随着进度推进，序章里那个老哥，最后被关在船舱底层那个是不是在一步一步变得越来越奇怪了？（不要什么东西都往船上运啊！！！！）

The Bad -The gameplay loop its self is very repetitive in the worst way. Meaning you start from square one every single game. Meaning there is essentially no reward for your work apart from unlocking a new map, and collecting in game tokens that simply do not stretch far enough to make you feel rewarded. THIS IS THE BIGGEST PROBLEM WITH THE GAME!!! -The general controls, navigating UI, and interacting with climbable surfaces in game are all absolutely maddening to use. TLDR this game is repetitive as hell in the worst way possible, but even with that the ambiance, and solid base for the gameplay still make it a fun play with friends. That being said, if the developers don't finish it it will be dead soon.

Sure, it's quite buggy, could be better optimized... but once you get past all that, this is a one-of-a-kind atmospheric horror-exploration-looter game. Especially if you know your Lovecraft. The setting is what sets this apart from the other... lethalcompanylikes? This is NOT an action game in the style of Left 4 Dead or Vermintides. You're not going to take down hundreds of monsters. Your characters are hopelessly underpowered and malnourished. Your captain is a ♥♥♥♥. Your weapons will break. (Luckily Far Cry 2 hogged all the malaria.) There are long periods of paranoiac sneaking through the forest with no action happening, just listening for signs of trouble and trying to spot valuables and threats. And then there's the hallucinations. The game employs a ton of wonderful mind tricks that I won't spoil here. The game has a baked-in voice chat and using that is mandatory because of the whole atmospheric thing, don't go ruining this game by using external voice comms. When someone strays far from the team and you don't hear their voice anymore... you're not meant to be sure if they're just really far away or some calamity has happened. There are no player outlines or pointers. If you get lost in the woods, hope that they can hear you. Having played over 20 hours now, I've had tons of fun and I want to explore more. If you have friends who'd be into games like this, this is an easy recommendation. It's been great playing just as a team of 2 or 3, so it doesn't fall into the usual trap of "you must have 4 players". If someone wants this to play solo... ehh, the sidekick bot is pretty useless as an ally, often getting completely stuck. After the initial missions I'd imagine playing with the bot becomes even worse, so maybe don't pick up the game if you're only going to play this in singleplayer. The audiovisual presentation here is glorious, ACE team have nailed that side once again. Even though the game isn't as constantly psychedelic as their other works, I'd still call the mundane side's presentation unique-looking. I love how the jungle is full of trees and stumps that clearly are made to look suspicious in the fog. (Don't trust them.) Just the ship you're using as the base between missions has a different oppressive feel to it. The game does come with quite hefty requirements and is a performance hog. I've not ran into complete showstopper bugs (once I found the right occult incantation for Proton), but at the time of writing this, patches and hotfixes sure are welcome. I'm hopeful because ACE team have a long history of supporting their games. Extra points for having developers who have actually read the source material instead of just adding tentacles to a horror game and calling it Cthulhu. It's not the most obvious Lovecraft story to make into a game and they succeeded, excellent work! (Everyone else, go and read "The Mound".)

《The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu》（克苏鲁恶兆）是一款支持1-4人游玩的搜打撤游戏，正如其副标题所见，游戏内融入了大量的克苏鲁元素，并借此营造出了不错的恐怖氛围和一些在我看来比较重口味的画面。就目前版本来说，虽然玩起来还不错，但是的确有不少缺点，后续更新后应该可以更好。在这一点上就最近的观察来说应该是很有机会达成的，本作的发行商Nacon在申请破产后并没有影响后续的游戏开发及推广，反而加大力度了，毕竟要努力赚钱嘛。 在游戏中，你可以和其他玩家组成一个最多4人的队伍，一起从帆船启航，前往被诅咒的丛林中接受充满克苏鲁风格的挑战。和其他搜打撤玩法的作品一样，你们需要深入各个地图中探索，在完成主线任务的同时，尽可能把一切的贵重物品带回来，通过结算将它们化为代币，为之后的探索提供便利。 游戏内的恐怖风格是洛夫克拉夫特式的，主要通过压抑诡异的氛围营造恐怖。比较反直觉的是，在这个充满克苏鲁元素的世界里，你的SAN值并没有明确的理智条帮你进行规划，而是需要通过场景中的光影和音效来感知。 另一方面，在进入地图前一定要仔细阅读舰长契约上的要求后再开始任务，否则没有注意到任务门槛和可用装备清单，很可能会被打回来从头开始。不过本作最好还是要在有队友一起的情况下再考虑游玩，单人带着人机队友打起来难度特别高，而且不能自定义出门装，能获得的局外成长也绝不算多。 以上的种种缺陷都需要团队协作，进行合理的配置和分工后才能从容应对。比如一人携带近战武器一人远程支援，其他人多留格子装战利品什么的，优秀的任务分配能够让你们玩起来更加事半功倍。对于搜打撤类型的游戏来说，在完成必要目标的基础上，搜寻战利品一定是游戏绝对的核心玩法，所以在保证战斗需求之外，有足够的格子带回战利品是非常重要的。 由于地图内宝藏的刷新地点是固定的，虽然游戏里的地图数量不是很少，但是在长期游玩后还是会感到重复性比极高。此外游戏中还有从嘴里吐虫子的事件频繁触发作为难点，不仅重口味还有可能造成翻车。 总体而言，《The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu》虽然是近年来火热的搜打撤玩法，但是融合了大量的克苏鲁元素做出了特色和差异性。和其他同类游戏不同的是，在游戏中千万不要选择单走来提高效率，因为孤独值变高引来的怪物和事件会让你陷入万劫不复之地，同时噪音也会吸引怪物，所以游戏的内核就是鼓励潜行，打枪滴不要悄悄滴进村，如果你有稳定的队友组成车队，就能够通过合理分工大大降低游戏难度，非常适合多人一起游玩。 [quote] 游玩百态，将游玩心得用汉语化作玩家的指明灯，(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402408/]点击这里关注汉化语录~[/url] 如果喜欢这个评测，请点个赞让更多人看见 [/quote]

克苏鲁的小说看的多了，但正真展现克苏鲁世界风貌的游戏少之又少，大多数都是仅仅借用一个背景而已，而本作《The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu》就是在原汁原味的设定上加入搜打撤要素和团队协作的独特动作游戏，游戏中玩家需要组建四人小队在克系味道极其浓郁的小岛上来合作探险，找寻宝藏，算是近期少有的题材独特玩法有趣的故事佳作了。 游戏开局那个划船探险的动画总让我想起刚玩老滚5坐马车谈话的场景，但不同的是本作核心玩法还是时下热门的搜打撤，具体就是四人组队进行探险，分配好厨师装备以后深入小岛探索收集各种值钱物品并护送这些装备来逃出生天。整套搜、打、撤的流程简洁易懂，难度循序渐进。每次探险的物资分配、路线规划、撤离时机抉择都需要团队配合，单人游玩的孤寂压迫感与多人联机的博弈乐趣形成鲜明反差，所以还是偏向于多人合作体验的（单人也可以玩，但是难度较大）。 本作最独特、最新颖、最少见、最独树一帜的就是这个san值系统了，在进行探索时玩家的励志会持续衰减，随之触发各类随机幻觉与感官错乱。就好比是云南人吃了菌子中毒那种感觉，到处都是莫名的低语、错位的场景光影，到凭空出现的怪物虚影、队友畸变的模型，错乱效果层层递进。尤其是会吧队友看成怪物这种“恶意设定”让游戏在奇幻之余多了几分欢乐。真的很有克苏鲁那味儿了 另外就是氛围感确实也不错，很有刚开始探索森林之子那种恐惧阴暗的感觉，本作把那种暗黑的环境和诡谲质感融合得淋漓尽致，比如说游戏中昏暗潮湿的丛林、斑驳破败的古遗迹、压抑的背景音效，搭配随机触发的灵异音效与场景异变，全程营造出绵长的未知恐惧，当然在一个搞怪的队友面前，这些都不是问题。 毕竟本作的另一个核心玩法就是团队协作么，不同于传统联机游戏的并肩作战，由于有迷幻机制的存在，让实际体验中团队协作既统一又斗争，既要互相掩护、共享物资、协助撤离，又要时刻提防队友的理智失控误伤，这种感觉也是我认为本作最有趣的地方。 缺点的话也比较明显，第一就是僵硬的动作体验，实话说在如今很少见完全不能跳跃的大型动作游戏了，要知道上一个因为这个被调侃的巫师3都已经是十多年前的事情了，此外整体人物操作有些迟滞，就像是被释放了迟缓术的士兵，打起来总感觉不是那么的得心应手。其次优化问题也挺明显，不过我看更新后体验好了不少。最后还有一个地方就是游戏地图有点大而空的感觉，导致很多地图玩起来都一个样，没有像鹅鸭杀那种明显的差异感，后续有待更新。 但总体来说本作对于喜欢克苏鲁风格、偏爱多人协作博弈、追求沉浸式心理恐怖体验的玩家，这款作品绝对值得尝试。 [quote] 游玩百态，将游玩心得用汉语化作玩家的指明灯，(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402408/]点击这里关注汉化语录~[/url] 如果喜欢这个评测，请点个赞让更多人看见 [/quote]

克苏鲁恶兆：创意十足的迷路模拟器 个人给予这部作品 7.0/10 分，属于“中规中矩”的范畴 +有创意的San值幻觉模式 +强沉浸感的森林探索体验 +较好的画质与武器质感 -糟糕的打击与动作感 -过于薄弱的场外成长系统 -待提高的地图设计 这是一部看着有趣但玩着难受的多人合作冒险游戏，设计非常有创意，令人眼前一亮，但玩法上问题很多。个人与两位好友开黑体验，测试时间7小时。 本作中玩家会加入1~4人的小队进入受诅咒的森林进行探索，搜刮宝藏与日志，从而推进剧情，看起来有些像克苏鲁版的《猎杀对决》。游戏最大的特色是加入的克苏鲁元素，玩家在森林中徘徊时间过长、被树枝刮破皮肤、受怪物攻击或看了不该看的地方等都会降低San值，当理智值偏低时，眼前会出现明显的幻觉，例如把队友看成怪物、陷阱看成宝箱等。由于每位玩家的理智值不同，所以同队的每个人看到的实际游玩画面都不一样，交流起来非常有趣。游戏中的克苏鲁风怪物外型与地图做得令人印象深刻，在克苏鲁神殿等关卡更是如此。 不过，本作在玩法上有许多不足。首先是游戏的动作和打击感很糟糕，玩家动作僵硬，且怪物受近战攻击后硬直接近于零。同时，近战推开怪的按键功能只有角色动作，怪并不会被推开，这导致玩家一旦被3~4只怪物包围几乎必死无疑，出路全被怪物模型卡着。本作的角色没有跳跃、闪避或格挡动作，且移动缓慢，怪冲过来只能挨打。 此外，虽然游戏类似搜打撤类型，但场外成长设计接近于零。玩家搜刮回来的武器装备都会自动被换成钱计算价值，而不能在下次出征时使用，每次出征都会给发默认武器。搜刮价值即使再多，也只能换到少得可怜的代币，甚至买地图都吃力，更不用说升级武器耗代币量极大，还是一次性的，投入产出完全不平衡。游戏虽然有多名可选择的角色，但在技能和武器上几乎没有区别。最后，本作的地图设计有明显缺陷，岔路很多且大部分岔路都是刻意坑人的存在，走进去很快就发现是死路，探索奖励也很少，导致玩几个小时就令人缺乏探索动力，最后无奈弃坑。
